rounds.text: The market is heavily discounting a company that trades below its net asset value with a price-to-book ratio of 0.88x, or 0.84x against a sector benchmark of 1.31x [E2, E7]. This asset-backed discount of ₹ 14.3 Cr market capitalization provides a margin of safety on the underlying book value of ₹ 14.4 per share [E2, E3]. More importantly, historical top-line contraction is reversing sharply as recent compounding shows a 26% growth rate over 3 years and a 19% growth rate over the trailing twelve months [E14, E15, E16, E17]. This recent acceleration surpasses the sector median sales growth of 16.3%, validating the screen reason that earnings growth is accelerating [E51, E57]. Conceded: [E1, E4, E6, E14, E15, E42].
